text:
alex: Heads-up — API team published a deprecation for the client param `model_id`. Removal target: 2026-05-01. Need a short migration guide, SDK shims plan, console copy, and a consistent banner. Who can own the docs PR?
maria: @sam @cheng can you two sync on SDK + docs? Also add a small compatibility note in the console quickstart.
sam: I can take SDK shims and changelogs. Plan: one-release compatibility shim that maps model_id -> model and emits a console warning. Will open PRs for Python and JS this week (refs: python#621, js#622).
docs-bot: created tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/912
julian: API note: we will accept model_id for an extra week and return a deprecation header `X-RW-Deprecation: model_id`. After the grace period it will return 400. We can spin up an advisory endpoint if teams need redirection.
cheng: I'll draft the migration guide. Suggest we show concise before/after snippets for REST + JS + Python SDKs, and a short note on the `prompt` -> `input` rename where applicable.
cheng: ```
# v1 REST (old)
POST /v1/generate
{ "model_id": "redwood-alpha-1", "prompt": "hi" }

# v2 REST (new)
POST /v2/generate
{ "model": "redwood-alpha-1", "input": "hi" }
```

cheng: JS SDK snippet (v1 -> v2):
```js
// old
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood-alpha-1', prompt: 'hi' })

// new
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha-1', input: 'hi' })
```

sam: For the shim I'm thinking:
```js
// compatibility shim (temporary)
if (opts.model_id) {
  opts.model = opts.model_id;
  console.warn('model_id deprecated — will be removed 2026-05-01');
}
```

alex: Banner text needs to be identical everywhere. Proposed copy: "model_id is deprecated and will be removed on 2026-05-01. Use `model`/`input` instead." Link to migration guide: /docs/migrate/model-param.
maria: Quick checklist for PRs and owners: 1) migration guide draft — cheng (docs PR), 2) update quickstarts/examples — cheng + docs owner, 3) SDK shims + changelogs — sam, 4) API deprecation header + infra rollout — julian, 5) console banner + redirect/quicklink — product (needs PR). Who volunteers for console copy PR?
sam: I'll open the SDK PRs and include changelog entries marking the shim temporary. Targeting next minor release; will add CI tests to capture the deprecation header behavior.
cheng: I'll drop the docs PR today and include the before/after snippets plus a small migration checklist and a troubleshooting FAQ line about 400 responses after cutoff. I'll link the PR to the tracking issue.
alex: Also ping @eng-runtime to run a quick smoke of our model swap path to ensure no regressions.
sam: ack — running unit and integration tests, will add a regression test to the CI that fails if shim removed early.
maria: Great. After docs PR lands, we should schedule a short announcement in #general and update the docs release notes.
alex: Thanks all — once PRs are open, drop links here and I'll coordinate the console banner rollout with product.
